title: The phone one-tap route to the picks is missing on /origination/ and /strategy/
detail: scripts/build.py::shell() renders the phone status strip (nav.mobile-status, 'N picks ready of M' + 'N unresolved · why') on every page it builds, and assets/scout.css shows it only at <=700px. Two views are then overwritten by their own builders — scripts/build_origination.py writes /origination/index.html and scripts/build_strategy.py writes /strategy/index.html — and neither shell carries the strip, so a reader on a phone who opens the complete picks list or the leaderboard plan loses the one-tap jump back to the picks and to the unresolved register. Verified by reading the built HTML: site/index.html, picks/, unresolved/, coverage/, methodology/, review/, edge/, twc-picks/ and final-day/ each contain exactly one nav.mobile-status; site/origination/index.html and site/strategy/index.html contain none. Fix requested in COORDINATION.md rather than applied here, because scripts/build_origination.py is touched by open PRs #245 and #238. Guard: tests/test_d202e156_brief_contract.py::PhoneReady fails if any third page loses the strip.

title: No scheduled or push refresh of the live site has completed since 2026-10-23T19:57Z
detail: Both code blockers of the publisher are now closed on main: the `NameError: name 'egw_live' is not defined' in scripts/originate.py::live_collect (PR #240) was fixed by PR #261, commit 292ea222, and the undeclared `import pytest` in tests/test_b97af12f_reconciliation.py (PR #267, d29a5602) that made `unittest discover` error and the regression step fail was fixed by commits 0427b814 and 6c051a73. What remains is coordination load: pages.yml uses concurrency group pages-${github.event_name} with cancel-in-progress:false, which cancels a *pending* run as soon as a newer push enters the group. Between 07:08Z and 07:31Z on 2026-10-24, seven push-triggered pages.yml runs (40072981546, 40073031665, 40073226352, 40073256691, 40073466836, 40073476964, 40073897762) were each cancelled while queued behind the next session's push, and no scheduled run had completed. The live site therefore still served the 2026-10-23T20:10:00Z snapshot (19 active fixtures, 19 with a pick) and showed its own "Snapshot needs attention" stale warning. This is a coordination load problem, not a data defect: the code on main builds and replays cleanly.

title: This sandbox cannot reach Hotspawn, HLTV, Polymarket, EGamersWorld or the published Pages host
detail: Outbound egress is limited to github.com, codeload.github.com, api.github.com, registry.npmjs.org, pypi.org and files.pythonhosted.org. Every TLS handshake to play.hotspawn.com, phpstack-1372681-6459848.cloudwaysapps.com, www.hltv.org, polymarket.com, gamma-api.polymarket.com, egamersworld.com, thunderpick.io, www.pinnacle.com and buffedlizard55-lab.github.io fails with 'TLS/SSL connection has been closed', and `npx playwright install chromium` cannot download Chrome for Testing. Consequence for this session: no live collection, no live lobby read and no local browser run. Everything verified here was verified against (a) the repository's own checked-in CI replay fixture data/latest.json and the build it produces, and (b) pages read through the platform page fetcher, whose content is quoted in data/research/d202e156/verification.md. No probability, pick or alias was changed by this session.

title: FIXED on main: tests/test_b97af12f_reconciliation.py was pytest-style, so the unittest runner CI uses collected zero of its six checks
detail: Reproduced on a clean worktree of origin/main at 06f56c2b: PR #267 (commit d29a5602) had added tests/test_b97af12f_reconciliation.py with six module-level `def test_*` functions, one taking the pytest `tmp_path` fixture, and a module-level `import pytest` that requirements.txt never declared. `python -m unittest discover -s tests` therefore reported "ERROR: test_b97af12f_reconciliation (ImportError: No module named 'pytest')" and exited non-zero, so pages.yml's regression step went red and the four-hour refresh died a second time, one commit after the egw_live NameError was fixed. Fixed on main in two commits: 0427b814 declared the pytest dependency in requirements.txt, and the owning session arena-b97af12f converted the module to unittest.TestCase in 6c051a73, so its six checks now actually run under the CI runner. tests/test_d202e156_declared_imports.py pins both halves: every third-party import must be declared, and every tests/test_*.py module must be collectable by the unittest runner (a second pytest-only module fails the suite).
